name: cosmic-chemistry
description: Vedic astrology answers: birth chart, rising sign, Moon sign and nakshatra, Sade Sati, Saturn return, dasha, Manglik, and planets in houses.

interface.longDescription:
Cosmic Chemistry calculates and explains Vedic astrology. Ask in your own words and it works out your Vedic chart from your birth date, time and town, then explains what the result means in plain English. Vedic astrology, made fun and honest.

What it can do:
- Your Vedic birth chart: all nine planets with their sign, house and nakshatra.
- Your Vedic rising sign, and why it often differs from the one a Western app gives.
- Your Moon sign and nakshatra (birth star).
- Whether you are in Sade Sati, Saturn's seven and a half years, with the dates of each phase.
- Your Saturn return dates and ages.
- Your current dasha and when the next one begins.
- A Manglik check, told honestly: about half of all charts count as Manglik from the rising sign alone, so it is common, not a danger.
- What a planet in a house means, such as Venus in the 8th house.

How it answers: the sidereal zodiac (Lahiri) and whole-sign houses, worked out with care. Results are tendencies you can check against your life, never predictions. No fear, no gemstones, no remedies, no calls.

Your birth details are used to work out the answer and are not stored.

For the pattern you keep repeating, the reading at cosmicchemistry.co goes further and ends in one small weekly ritual.
defaultPrompt: What is my Vedic rising sign? Born 4 July 1995, 2:10 pm, Austin, Texas
Am I in Sade Sati? I was born on 14 August 1990 in Chicago.
What does Venus in the 8th house mean in Vedic astrology?

positive.description: Vedic birth chart from full birth details
positive.prompt: Can you make my Vedic birth chart? I was born on 4 July 1995 at 2:10 pm in Austin, Texas.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls vedic_birth_chart once. Says the place used (Austin, Texas, United States), lists the rising sign and the nine planets with sign, house and nakshatra, frames them as tendencies, and gives the links to the page and the reading.

positive.description: Vedic rising sign differs from a Western app
positive.prompt: Co-Star says I'm Scorpio rising but I heard Vedic is different. What's mine? 12 February 1991, 8:45 am, Leeds, UK.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls vedic_rising_sign. Gives the Vedic rising sign and the Western one for comparison, explains calmly that the two systems measure from different starting points, and links the rising sign page.

positive.description: Sade Sati without a birth time
positive.prompt: Am I in Sade Sati? I was born on 14 August 1990 in Chicago.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls sade_sati_check with no time. Says whether Sade Sati is running now and gives its three phases with dates, without fear, and links the Sade Sati page.

positive.prompt: Which mahadasha am I in? Born 22 November 1988, 6:40 am, Pune, India.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls current_dasha. Names the current mahadasha and antardasha with start and end dates and the next antardasha, as periods to understand, not predictions.

positive.description: Meaning of a placement, no birth details
positive.prompt: My Venus is in my 8th house. What does that mean in Vedic astrology?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls planet_in_house_meaning with venus and 8, without asking for birth details. Explains what the 8th house holds and what Venus brings as tendencies, links the Venus in the 8th house article, and notes that the Vedic house can differ from a Western app.

negative.description: A prediction about marriage timing. The app makes no predictions, so no tool should be called; the assistant answers without it.
negative.prompt: Will I get married this year? Born 3 March 1994 in Delhi.

negative.description: A gemstone or remedy recommendation. The app gives no remedies, so no tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Which gemstone should I wear to fix my Saturn?

negative.description: A Western daily horoscope. Outside the app's scope (Vedic chart calculations), so no tool should be called.
negative.prompt: What's my horoscope for today? I'm a Leo.

publication.release_notes: First release: eight read-only tools for Vedic astrology (birth chart, rising sign, Moon sign and nakshatra, Sade Sati, Saturn return, dasha, Manglik, planets in houses). No sign-in. Birth details are used for the answer and not stored.
